name: iroh-share-web
description: Browser interface (Rust + WebAssembly) for the iroh-share daemon

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build -p iroh-share-web --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen ../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/iroh_share_web.wasm --out-dir web/wasm --target web --no-typescript
scripts.build:debug: cargo build -p iroh-share-web --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen ../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/debug/iroh_share_web.wasm --out-dir web/wasm --target web --no-typescript --debug && node scripts/bundle.mjs
